text.p: Forasol-Foramer NV said Tuesday shareholders had overwhelmingly approved the sale of its operating subsidiaries to Pride Petroleum Services Inc, the dissolution of the company, and a liquidating distribution to shareholders.
The shareholder approval satisfies the last condition to the closing of the Pride transaction, the company said.
Pride will issue about 11.1 million common shares and pay about $113.2 million in the deal.

Forasol-Foramer shareholders of record March 10 will receive 0.66 share of Pride and $6.80 cash (less applicable Dutch withholding taxes) for each Forasol-Foramer share, the company said. The payment will be made by March 14.

Belgian holding company Ackermans & Van Haaren's ownership of 30 percent of Forasol-Foramer will leave it with about 6.0 percent of the roughly 50 million Pride shares outstanding after the transaction, a company spokesman said.
Shares of Forasol-Foramer were delisted from NASDAQ as of the close of the market yesterday.
